object.description: After a fresh install, list the third-party components the install folder contains (each bundled library and program, including the typesetting program) and open LICENSE and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt there. Expected: LICENSE holds the full text of GPL-3.0; THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt holds a licence notice for each listed component, and lists no component that isn't there.
